title: Roger Goodell says NFL would welcome investigation into Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Roger Goodell says NFL would welcome investigation into Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots
sources.description: The NFL Players Assn. issued a statement calling for an investigation into the handling of Eagles QB Jalen Hurts' blood clots. 'That's fine,' commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday.
